blocks.h2: When Your Geneva Sewer Line Needs Repair
blocks.intro: These are signs of a damaged pipe, not just a clog:

tiles.h3: The Basement Drain Backs Up Again and Again
tiles.body: If a cleared line backs up within months, something in the pipe is catching debris.
A basement shower or floor drain that bubbles when upstairs fixtures run.
Soil settling into a broken section leaves a dip in the lawn or walk.
Cracks, roots, offset joints or a sag.

blocks.h2: Why Sewer Lines Fail in Geneva
blocks.intro: Geneva's homes range from the 1840s to today. About 1 in 10 was built before 1940, and more than 4 in 10 after 1990.

items.body: Most houses in the Central Geneva Historic District were built between 1840 and 1900. Lines that old are usually clay, often repaired in pieces over the decades, and every joint is a way in for roots.
The tree-lined blocks near downtown are beautiful, and the roots under them go straight for sewer joints.
Homes between the historic core and the newer subdivisions often have older materials that are now close to 50 years old or more.
West side homes from the 1990s and 2000s have PVC lines, but sections can sag where the soil settled after construction.

blocks.h2: How We Repair Sewer Lines in Geneva
blocks.intro: From our Campbell Street office, sewer work always starts with the camera.

steps.body: We camera it from the cleanout to the main and mark every problem's distance and depth.

steps.h3: 2. Size the Fix to the Damage
steps.body: A spot repair for one section, lining or replacement for a failing line, with the footage to back it up.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.h2: How We Repair a Sewer Line
blocks.intro: Once we know what's wrong, there's usually more than one way to fix it. Which method makes sense depends on the pipe's condition, location, and how it failed.
head: Method
What It Involves
Typical Disruption
rows: A resin-coated liner is pulled through the existing pipe and cured in place, creating a new pipe inside the old one.
Minimal digging, usually just small access points
A new pipe is pulled through the old one while a bursting head fractures the old pipe outward to make room.
Minimal digging, works even when the old pipe is badly damaged
The damaged section is dug up and replaced directly.
More digging, but sometimes the only option depending on damage location and access
blocks.note: Historic Geneva lots often have mature trees, brick walks and garden walls over the sewer path. The camera tells us which method protects them.

blocks.h2: Sewer Repair Questions From Geneva Homeowners

items.q: My home is in Geneva's historic district. How old is my sewer line?
items.preview: Possibly as old as the house, with patches over the years.
items.answer: It could be original clay pipe or a mix of sections replaced over the decades. A [camera inspection](/geneva/video-camera-sewer-inspections) shows exactly what's down there before you spend anything.

items.q: Can you repair a sewer line without disturbing my landscaping?
items.answer: Often. [Trenchless repair](/geneva/trenchless-sewer-repair) works through small openings, so mature trees, brick walks and garden beds can usually stay in place.

items.q: Should I fix the sewer line before remodeling my basement?
items.preview: Yes. Check it on camera before the new floor goes in.
items.answer: Yes. If you're finishing or remodeling a basement in an older Geneva home, camera the line and the drains under the floor first. Fixing a broken pipe before the new floor goes in costs far less than tearing it up later.

items.q: Who is responsible for my sewer line?
items.preview: Usually the owner, from the building to the main.
items.answer: Usually the property owner, from the building to the public main. If the problem is in the main, we'll tell you.

items.q: How much does sewer line repair cost in Geneva?
items.preview: That depends on the damage and the method. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what the camera finds, how deep and long the damaged section is, the method and what's on top of it. You'll see and approve a flat-rate price before any work begins.
